objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed artifact that is created, edited, released, and archived in the system; subject to versioning, workflow approval, and distribution to readers.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Classification of the document (e.g., Policy, Guideline, Work Instruction, Procedural Instruction)

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state of the document in its lifecycle (e.g., Editing, Released, Out of Force, Archived)

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Sequential version number of the document

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the document becomes valid

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date after which the document is no longer valid

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: User responsible for creating and signing the document

attributes.name: co_author
attributes.description: Additional user with change rights to the document

attributes.name: reviewer
attributes.description: User responsible for checking technical and formal aspects

attributes.name: releaser
attributes.description: User responsible for approving and releasing the document

attributes.name: translator
attributes.description: User responsible for translating released content

attributes.name: reader
attributes.description: User group with authorization to view the document

attributes.name: archive_group
attributes.description: User group with access to archived documents

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: Document identifier prefix assigned to the document

attributes.name: document_number
attributes.description: Consecutive number assigned to the document

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Other documents or entities referenced by this document

attributes.name: it_application
attributes.description: IT systems related to the document

attributes.name: company
attributes.description: Organizational entity for which the document applies

attributes.name: area_of_validity
attributes.description: Scope or jurisdiction to which the document applies

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Period for which a document remains archived before physical deletion

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled document automatically released with the main document; has its own versioning but is subject to the main document's release status and cannot be independently deleted when released.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state of the attachment in the release cycle

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Sequential version number of the attachment

objs.name: additional_information
objs.description: An uncontrolled supplement to a document that is not subject to the main document's release cycle and can be directly published or deleted without creating a new version of the main document.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A request to amend a document without affecting its content or version history; managed separately and can be scheduled for implementation.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state of the change proposal (e.g., Pending, Scheduled, Completed)

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: An automatically created request triggered 30 days before a document's validity expires; must be processed to extend or revise the document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state of the validity extension request

objs.name: override_request
objs.description: A request to invalidate and archive a document that has no additional validity or is no longer required in circulation.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state of the override request

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: A request to re-validate a previously invalidated and archived document, initiated by the Business Admin group.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state of the reactivation request

objs.name: user
objs.description: A person who interacts with the system in various roles such as author, reviewer, releaser, reader, or translator.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: Function assigned to the user (e.g., Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Reader, Translator, Business Admin)

attributes.name: user_group
attributes.description: Organizational grouping for access control and distribution

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A collection of users grouped for access control, distribution, and role-based functionality.

attributes.name: group_name
attributes.description: Name identifying the user group

attributes.name: purpose
attributes.description: Function of the group (e.g., Reader group, Archive group)

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A maintained record of users and user groups assigned to receive a document and participate in acknowledgement or email notification workflows.

attributes.name: distribution_by_email
attributes.description: Whether users are notified by email when new versions are released

attributes.name: distribution_for_acknowledgement
attributes.description: Whether users are required to actively confirm receipt of the document

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: A workflow-supported confirmation by a user that they have received and reviewed a document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Whether the acknowledgement has been confirmed

objs.name: template
objs.description: A predefined structure for creating new documents of a specific type, optionally including metadata tags.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Type of document for which the template is defined

attributes.name: format
attributes.description: File format of the template (e.g., MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint)

objs.name: signature
objs.description: An electronic record of a user's approval or action on a document or workflow task.

attributes.name: participant
attributes.description: User who provided the signature

attributes.name: step
attributes.description: Workflow step at which the signature was provided

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: A user-facing interface displaying documents and workflow tasks relevant to the user based on distribution and role.

attributes.name: user
attributes.description: User for whom the dashboard is configured

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: Role-specific configuration of the dashboard

objs.name: report
objs.description: An evaluation or search result providing filtered information about documents and their statuses based on selected parameters.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Category of report (e.g., Status Report, Evaluation Report)

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: Role for which the report is configured

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Attach a new information object of a specified document type to the system, optionally based on a template.

evts.name: edit_document
evts.description: Modify the content or properties of a document, including metadata and document body.

evts.name: assign_author
evts.description: Designate a user as the author responsible for a document.

evts.name: assign_co_author
evts.description: Designate an additional user with change rights to a document.

evts.name: assign_reviewer
evts.description: Designate a user to review the technical and formal aspects of a document.

evts.name: assign_releaser
evts.description: Designate a user responsible for approving and releasing a document.

evts.name: assign_translator
evts.description: Designate a user to translate released document content.

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: Update the list of users and user groups assigned to receive or acknowledge a document.

evts.name: initiate_release_workflow
evts.description: Start the three-step approval process (Creator-Review-Release) for a document.

evts.name: sign_document
evts.description: Electronically sign a document or workflow task as part of the approval process.

evts.name: approve_document
evts.description: Confirm release of a document by a releaser, making it available to readers.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Make a released document visible to designated readers in the system.

evts.name: create_attachment
evts.description: Add a controlled attachment to a document that will be released with the main document.

evts.name: create_additional_information
evts.description: Add uncontrolled supplementary content to a document.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Submit a proposed amendment to an existing released document without modifying its version history.

evts.name: implement_change_proposal
evts.description: Schedule and execute a change proposal, creating a new version of the affected document.

evts.name: create_validity_extension_request
evts.description: Automatically generate or manually initiate a request to extend a document's validity period.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Approve extension of a document's validity period without creating a new version.

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: Initiate a request to invalidate and archive a document no longer required in circulation.

evts.name: approve_override
evts.description: Confirm invalidation of a document and revoke all access rights except for the archive group.

evts.name: archive_document
evts.description: Withdraw a document from circulation by revoking user authorizations while retaining it for the archive duration.

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: Submit a request to re-validate a previously archived document.

evts.name: approve_reactivation
evts.description: Confirm reactivation of an archived document, creating a new version with restored metadata and properties.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Create a language-dependent version of a released document for authorized readers in a different language.

evts.name: approve_translation
evts.description: Release a translated document version so it is visible to authorized readers in their login language.

evts.name: send_email_notification
evts.description: Inform users via email of document release or workflow task assignment.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Notify assigned users to actively confirm receipt and review of a document.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Actively acknowledge receipt and review of a document by a user.

evts.name: convert_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatically convert a document from its source format to PDF for web display.

evts.name: generate_report
evts.description: Produce a filtered evaluation or search result of documents based on selected parameters and user role.

o2o.description: A document may have one or more attachments; attachments are controlled by and released with the main document.
A document may have one or more additional information supplements; these are independent of the main document's release cycle.
A change proposal is linked to and proposes amendments to a specific document.
A document may reference other documents; documents can be linked through the References attribute.
A validity extension request is created for and linked to a document approaching its expiration date.
An override request is created for and associated with a document to be invalidated.
A reactivation request references an archived document to be re-validated.
A document is created based on an optional template of its corresponding type.
A distribution list is maintained for a document to define recipients for email notification and acknowledgement.
A user is a member of one or more user groups for role-based access control and distribution.
A distribution list contains direct assignments of specific users.
A distribution list contains assignments of user groups whose members receive the distribution.
